worldcombat.skill.obstruct.summary: Raise a barricade and root yourself in place: it fully blocks enemy damage up to a pool, and contact attackers lose a lot of Defence. Using it again in quick succession tends to fail.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.description.0: The barricade lasts %1$s and holds %2$s points, fully blocking enemy damage until spent and shattering; anything beyond the remaining pool passes through. A contact attacker loses %3$s Defence stages, once per foe.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.description.2: Repeat-use failure rate %1$s; barbed adds +1 to the contact Defence drop with x0.75 pool, x0.85 duration and 6-tick recovery; reinforced gives x1.2 pool, x1.15 duration and 10-tick recovery.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.0: Bait a melee foe onto the barricade
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.1: Soften a foe before your follow-up
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.use.2: Plant yourself in a chokepoint and tank a volley
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.preference.ba: On (barbed): contact drop +1, but pool x0.75, duration x0.85, recover 6 ticks. Off (reinforced): pool x1.2, duration x1.15, no extra drop, recover 10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.preference.ai: Raise once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
worldcombat.skill.obstruct.description.h: While the barricade stands the user is rooted in place and cannot move; the user's own damage (falls, burns) does not drain it.
